narr: Heavy rainfall produced flash flooding across portions of Walker and Grimes Counties.
ev: Floodwaters covered roadways around the FM 2929/FM 2296 intersection.
FM 2989 was closed due to floodwaters making the road impassable.
FM247 was closed between Huntsville and Midway due to floodwaters making the roadway impassable.
Floodwaters covered roads around the intersection of FM1774 and County Road 302.
lsr: FM 247 CLOSED BETWEEN HUNTSVILLE AND MIDWAY DUE TO FLOODING.
WATER ON ROADWAY AT FM 2929/FM 2296 INTERSECTION.
WATER OVER ROADWAY AT FM 1774 NEAR COUNTY ROAD 302. REPORT FROM TXDOT.
